business.title: Prudential slides after report on China offshore insurance tax
business.description: Aug 5 (Reuters) - Shares in Prudential fell more than 10% on Wednesday after Caixin reported that Chinese mainland tax authorities have started levying personal income tax on returns from offshore insurance policies. According to the report, authorities in Beijing and Hangzhou had already enforced the measures, applying a 20% tax rate to returns from Hong Kong policies. Other Asia-focused financial stocks were also under pressure with HSBC falling 5.5% and Standard Chartered down over 4%.

science.title: Saskatchewan skies offer a view of the Milky Way’s centre in August
science.description: For many people, the Milky Way is something seen only in photographs, but Saskatchewan’s dark skies offer opportunities to view the galaxy with the naked eye. August is one of the best times of the year to see the Milky Way from Saskatchewan, according to Abigail Sadowski, a resident Astra member with the Kalium Observatory in Regina. From a dark location, the galaxy appears as a pale, cloudy band stretching across the night sky. Sadowski said people who see it for the first time sometimes mistake it for something else. “Sometimes when people first see it, they think it’s a cloud or a dust patch because so many people can’t see it because of light pollution,” Sadowski said.
